content.json:
## SIEM Security Overview
Centralised view of all eight log sources: ingestion health, authentication failures across sources, web traffic and attack indicators, and Sentinel incidents. Use the time range to look back over the collected history.

content.query:
union isfuzzy=true withsource=TableName NginxAccess_CL, WebAppAudit_CL, Syslog, SecurityEvent, Event, AzureActivity, SigninLogs, AuditLogs, OktaV2_CL
| extend Source = case(
    TableName == "NginxAccess_CL", "Web server (Nginx)",
    TableName == "WebAppAudit_CL", "Web application (audit)",
    TableName == "Syslog" and Facility == "local0", "Container",
    TableName == "Syslog", "Linux system",
    TableName in ("SecurityEvent", "Event"), "Windows",
    TableName == "AzureActivity", "Cloud provider (Azure)",
    TableName in ("SigninLogs", "AuditLogs"), "Directory (Entra ID)",
    TableName == "OktaV2_CL", "SaaS (Okta)",
    TableName)
| summarize Events = count(), LastEvent = max(TimeGenerated) by Source
// Continuous sources should report within 60 minutes. Identity sources only log
// when someone signs in, so they get a 24-hour allowance.
| lookup kind=leftouter (datatable(Source: string, ExpectedWithinMinutes: int) [
    "Directory (Entra ID)", 1440,
    "SaaS (Okta)", 1440
  ]) on Source
| extend ExpectedWithinMinutes = coalesce(ExpectedWithinMinutes, 60)
| extend MinutesSinceLastEvent = datetime_diff("minute", now(), LastEvent)
| extend Status = iff(MinutesSinceLastEvent > ExpectedWithinMinutes, "Check source", "Healthy")
| project Source, Status, Events, LastEvent, MinutesSinceLastEvent, ExpectedWithinMinutes
| order by Source asc
content.title: Ingestion health: last event per source

content.query:
union isfuzzy=true withsource=TableName NginxAccess_CL, WebAppAudit_CL, Syslog, SecurityEvent, Event, AzureActivity, SigninLogs, AuditLogs, OktaV2_CL

content.query:
let AuthFailures = union isfuzzy=true
    (WebAppAudit_CL
        | extend e = parse_json(RawData)
        | where tostring(e.event) == "login_failed"
        | project TimeGenerated, Source = "Web app", Account = tostring(e.user), SourceIP = tostring(e.src_ip)),
    (Syslog
        | where Facility in ("auth", "authpriv") and ProcessName == "sshd"
        | where SyslogMessage has_any ("Failed password", "Invalid user")
        | extend SourceIP = extract(@"from (\d{1,3}(?:\.\d{1,3}){3})", 1, SyslogMessage),
                 Account  = extract(@"(?:[Ii]nvalid user|Failed password for(?: invalid user)?) (\S+)", 1, SyslogMessage)
        | project TimeGenerated, Source = "Linux SSH", Account, SourceIP),
    (SecurityEvent
        | where EventID == 4625
        | project TimeGenerated, Source = "Windows", Account = TargetUserName, SourceIP = IpAddress),
    (SigninLogs
        | where ResultType in ("50126", "50053", "50055")
        | project TimeGenerated, Source = "Entra ID", Account = UserPrincipalName, SourceIP = IPAddress),
    (OktaV2_CL
        | where tostring(column_ifexists("EventOriginalType", "")) == "user.session.start"
        | where tostring(column_ifexists("EventResult", "")) =~ "Failure"
        | project TimeGenerated, Source = "Okta",
                  Account  = tostring(column_ifexists("ActorUsername", "")),
                  SourceIP = tostring(column_ifexists("SrcIpAddr", "")));
AuthFailures
| summarize Failures = count() by Source, bin(TimeGenerated, {TimeRange:grain})
content.title: Failed logins by source over time

content.query:
let AuthFailures = union isfuzzy=true
    (WebAppAudit_CL
        | extend e = parse_json(RawData)
        | where tostring(e.event) == "login_failed"
        | project TimeGenerated, Source = "Web app", Account = tostring(e.user), SourceIP = tostring(e.src_ip)),
    (Syslog
        | where Facility in ("auth", "authpriv") and ProcessName == "sshd"
        | where SyslogMessage has_any ("Failed password", "Invalid user")
        | extend SourceIP = extract(@"from (\d{1,3}(?:\.\d{1,3}){3})", 1, SyslogMessage),
                 Account  = extract(@"(?:[Ii]nvalid user|Failed password for(?: invalid user)?) (\S+)", 1, SyslogMessage)
        | project TimeGenerated, Source = "Linux SSH", Account, SourceIP),
    (SecurityEvent
        | where EventID == 4625
        | project TimeGenerated, Source = "Windows", Account = TargetUserName, SourceIP = IpAddress),
    (SigninLogs
        | where ResultType in ("50126", "50053", "50055")
        | project TimeGenerated, Source = "Entra ID", Account = UserPrincipalName, SourceIP = IPAddress),
    (OktaV2_CL
        | where tostring(column_ifexists("EventOriginalType", "")) == "user.session.start"
        | where tostring(column_ifexists("EventResult", "")) =~ "Failure"
        | project TimeGenerated, Source = "Okta",
                  Account  = tostring(column_ifexists("ActorUsername", "")),
                  SourceIP = tostring(column_ifexists("SrcIpAddr", "")));
AuthFailures
| where isnotempty(SourceIP) and SourceIP != "-"
| summarize Failures = count(), Sources = make_set(Source), DistinctAccounts = dcount(Account), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated) by SourceIP
| top 10 by Failures
content.title: Top 10 source IPs with failed logins

content.query:
NginxAccess_CL
| extend e = parse_json(RawData)
| extend SourceIP = tostring(e.remote_addr), Uri = tostring(e.request_uri), Status = toint(e.status)
| extend StatusClass = strcat(tostring(Status / 100), "xx")
| summarize Requests = count() by StatusClass, bin(TimeGenerated, {TimeRange:grain})
content.title: Web responses by status class over time

content.query:
NginxAccess_CL
| extend e = parse_json(RawData)
| extend SourceIP = tostring(e.remote_addr), Uri = tostring(e.request_uri), Status = toint(e.status)
| where Uri has_any (dynamic(["/.env", "/.git", "/wp-admin", "/wp-login", "/xmlrpc.php", "/phpmyadmin", "/admin.php", "/config", "/cgi-bin", "/vendor/phpunit", "/server-status", "/.aws"]))
| summarize Probes = count(), SourceIPs = dcount(SourceIP), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated) by Uri
| top 15 by Probes
content.title: Most probed sensitive paths

content.query:
WebAppAudit_CL
| extend e = parse_json(RawData)
| summarize Events = count() by Event = tostring(e.event)
| order by Events desc
content.title: Web application security events

content.query:
SecurityIncident
| summarize arg_max(LastModifiedTime, *) by IncidentNumber
| where Title has_any ("Brute-force", "Web vulnerability scanning")
| project IncidentNumber, Title, Severity, Status, CreatedTime, LastModifiedTime
| order by CreatedTime desc
content.title: Sentinel incidents from this project's rules
